description: Find crowdfunding campaigns. Search by offering amount, deadline, offered types (Common Stock, etc.), and portal.

days.description: Number of days to look back (e.g., 7, 30, 60)

keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against title/description (comma-separated for several)

location.description: City, state or country title, e.g. "Texas"

new_since_last_pull.description: Only rows this account has not already been shown by an earlier new_since_last_pull call with the same filters. Fundz remembers per account and filter set, so a daily agent run gets just what is new, with no dates to track. The first call returns the normal window (days or since) and starts the marker. Ignores page: if more new rows are waiting the reply says so; call again the same way for the next batch. Needs a signed-in account.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` results; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

since.description: Only results Fundz added on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01" (whole day, so a daily run may repeat that day). Overrides days. Use the date of your last run to get only what is new.

name: search_crowdfunding
title: Search crowdfunding rounds
